_notes: Hand-built sector levels: what each sector's level contains and where. Tools/build_sector_level.py builds the level from this (run it in the editor) and Tools/validate_galaxy.py checks it.
Positions are cm from the sector marker at the origin. N=+X, E=+Y. Jump gates spawn 2 km (200000) out toward their destination; the builder refuses content within 400 m of one.

stations[].layout: a station in LevelStationLayouts.json (also its actor label). market: an asset in /Game/DataAssets/Trading/Markets. Stations stay at yaw 0: their modules are laid out on world axes.
fields[]: an AAsteroidField; ores are crafting item ids (the sector POI's resources). Rock, ice, gas pockets and wreck debris are all fields.
planets[]: a sphere of the given radius (cm) with a planet material (Tools/ue_make_planet_materials.py); tilt rolls its bands.
props[]: plain meshes (beacons, caches, derelicts) until those POIs get gameplay. hidden: not shown on maps once POI discovery exists.

sun: the star's light; intensity falls off with the sector's orbitRadius unless set here. Everything the builder places is tagged SectorKit and rebuilt on every run; hand-placed extras without the tag are kept.

adastrea_relay.brief: The edge of the Compact's space: a fuel stop and free market beside the lane gate to Kestrel, old wrecks nobody has bothered to clear, a thin ice field, and a smugglers' cache hidden behind a dead rock.

kestrel_port.brief: The Kestrel Port Authority's seat and the busiest fuel stop on the lanes: the port itself facing arrivals from Adastrea, a waystation where crews rest between jumps, and a little ice for the port's water.

kestrel_skim.brief: Fuel skimmers over the giant Kestrel IV: the planet fills the sky below, gas pockets drift in its upper storm bands, and the Skimmer Platform turns what the drones bring up into fuel.

kestrel_edge.brief: Sparse outer space at the edge of Kestrel, low security and favoured by smugglers: a thin zinc and manganese field, and a cache tucked into a dead rock away from both lanes.
